compute_eikonal_loss: compute the eikonal loss for backward warped points using an MLP and positional embedding
compute_visibility_loss: compute visibility loss from positive and negative samples using an MLP and positional embedding
compute_feat_match_loss: compute feature matching loss between NeRF features and 3D points using expected point regression
compute_rtk_loss: compute rotation and translation loss between predicted and ground truth rigid transformation matrices
compute_shape_init_loss: compute signed distance function loss between an MLP and a mesh using sampled points
